params.name: a
params.choice: [v for v in range(-9, 10) if v != 0]

params.name: b
params.choice: [v for v in range(-9, 10) if v != 0]

params.name: qn
params.let: "first" if (a > 0 and b > 0) else ("second" if (a < 0 and b > 0) else ("third" if (a < 0 and b < 0) else "fourth"))

stem: The point $A({=a}, {=b})$ is given. Find the coordinates of the point symmetric to $A$ with respect to the {=nm}.
solution: $A$ has $x = {=a}$ and $y = {=b}$, so it lies in the {=qn} quadrant.
Reflection in the x-axis gives $(x, -y)$; in the y-axis gives $(-x, y)$; in the origin gives $(-x, -y)$.
With respect to the {=nm}, the symmetric point is $({=rx}, {=ry})$.
notes: Single skeleton: reflect a point in x-axis, y-axis or origin. Coordinates are never zero.
